suppress.notes: False positive: io.quarkus:quarkus-flyway-postgresql is the Quarkus Flyway extension for PostgreSQL (Java code). Its artifact name matches the PostgreSQL *server* CPE, so it inherits server CVEs from 2015-2021 that do not apply to a client-side extension. The server itself runs from the postgres:17 image, which Trivy scans in images.yml. Review when Quarkus or dependency-check changes the CPE match (first seen 2026-11-02, dependency-check 13.0.0).

False positive (WP64, 2026-11-06): CVE-2026-0871 is a Keycloak *server* flaw (user-profile unmanaged attributes, fixed in server 26.4.0). keycloak-admin-client is the REST client library we call from core-service; it contains none of the server code. The server runs from the Keycloak image, scanned by Trivy in images.yml. Review when the CPE match changes.

False positive (WP64, 2026-11-06): CVE-2026-54285 affects the opentelemetry-js package @opentelemetry/core (CPE opentelemetry:opentelemetry for node.js, fixed 2.8.0). The matched artifacts are the Java opentelemetry-api jars, which contain no JavaScript baggage propagator. Review when the CPE match changes.
